verdict.rationale: CoreWeave exposes broad programmatic surfaces. The CKS API can create, list, update and delete clusters. The Terraform provider covers CKS, VPC, AI Object Storage and Managed Inference. The Inference API controls gateways, deployments and capacity claims, with generated clients in many languages. Storage is S3-compatible, and the FOCUS API (preview) exports usage. However, several workflows appear only in the Cloud Console, including Capacity Finder, quota viewing and increase requests, and billing insights, and nothing states the API matches the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, documented API equivalents for Capacity Finder and quota management, GA (not preview) billing API, independent corroboration.
